title: Synthetic COVID-like outbreak in a mid-sized city (SEIRV)
honesty_note: This dataset is entirely synthetic and was produced by the SEIRV model in seir_model.py with the parameters below. It does not contain real surveillance data.
generation_method: True SEIRV trajectory integrated with scipy solve_ivp (RK45, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8) on a 0.25-day grid with breakpoint-split integration at schedule jumps. Daily clinical cases are the integral of sigma*E over each day (first differences of the cumulative clinical counter at day boundaries). Reported cases are drawn per day as Poisson(rho * clinical_cases); daily vaccinations are the modelled nu(t)*S(t) flow integrated over each day and rounded to integers. Cumulative columns are running sums of the daily columns.
